prompt:
Assess the risk: A steel fabrication company plans to begin operations with a new robotic welding cell. The cell will perform MIG welding on structural steel components that require certified weld procedures (WPS). Risks include: weld parameter drift, insufficient NDE coverage on robot welds, operator intervention in automated cycle, UV/fume exposure during manual loading, and qualification of robot welds under AWS D1.1.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- riskLevel (string): overall risk level rating
- likelihood (string): likelihood of the risk occurring
- impact (string): impact of the issue
- controls (string): controls to mitigate the risk

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"riskLevel":"High","likelihood":"Likely","impact":"Severe","controls":"Implement real-time weld parameter monitoring with automated alerts and statistical process control; design comprehensive NDE inspection plan including automated ultrasonic or radiographic testing; minimize operator intervention through proper training, SOPs, and safety interlocks; use engineering controls (local exhaust ventilation, fume extraction) and PPE (UV welding helmets, respirators) to reduce UV/fume exposure; qualify robot welding procedure per AWS D1.1 with mock-up testing and documentation; maintain thorough records of parameters, inspections, and qualifications; provide regular training for operators and engineers; conduct periodic risk reviews."}
